avis.titre: Such a pretty bottle and it feels so great on skin!Such a pretty bottle and it feels so great on skin!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this serum, and honestly, it did not disappoint. What first caught my eye was the packaging—I’m a sucker for pretty bottles, and this one is stunning with its shimmery, rainbow-like colors. Even the serum itself has a subtle shimmer that matches the bottle, which I absolutely love. The scent was the first thing I noticed. It has a light floral smell with a hint of honey, almost like a soft version of the old Sweet Pea scent from Bath & Body Works. It’s not overpowering at all. You only really smell it when dispensing or applying it—once it’s on your skin, the scent completely disappears. No headaches, no lingering fragrance. Application-wise, this serum is silky smooth and spreads beautifully. It made me realize my skin wasn’t as soft as I thought—because after using this, my skin felt noticeably softer, hydrated, and plump. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling nourished without being greasy. It does contain retinol, so the warnings about avoiding the eye area and limiting sun exposure are important. I’ll definitely be pairing this with a good hydrating sunscreen, especially during daytime use. I plan to ease into it by using it once or twice a week until my skin fully adjusts. Overall, I love everything about this serum—the packaging, the light scent, the texture, and the results. My skin feels smooth, hydrated, and healthy. This is definitely a product I’m excited to keep using and would happily recommend.

This stuff is amazing! I am getting benefits I never dreamed…I have only had it 3 days but had to report my immediate results! I have a patch of seborrhea on my left eyelid that is an annoyance daily. I tried this serum on my eye and no burning or stinging. No irritation at all! I put my makeup on and thought little more of it. At the end of the day, no dry flaky patch or makeup issues there at all! No eye itching or irritation all day! This is something I thought I just had to live with. As for the general serum I think the lines around my eyes are less prominent and my skin feels soft and moisturized. And last I love the large bottle! Great value! And I am not embarrassed to have the bottle sitting on my sink… Overall I think it is liquid gold for a bargain price! Will definitely buy again. Truly unexpected miracle in a bottle! Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Made of Excellent Ingredients based in YUKA App.
avis.texte: I usually buy this in physical store however, since the price are the same either through here in Amazon or physical stores, I decided to buy it here for a hassle free shopping. I love that it was packed so nicely. It arrived on sealed packaging and it is authentic Olay Super Serum that I always buy instores. What I love about this product? I started using it in 2024. I am Asian (Filipina), 36yrs old and is in Texas now. Living in Texas was kinda like Philippines but it gave me itchiness and pimples. I used Ponds often when in Philippines but using it in Texas gives me the results that never ever happened when still in Philippines. Like: redness, easily gets sunburn, dry face, itchy face, oily skin. Later on I scan this Olay Super Serum using the YUKA App. It said this product is made of excellent ingredients and that’s how I started using this product. I started with a trial size then later bought the bigger size. If you have pimples, make sure to wash it with mild cold water. NOT HOT OR LUKEWARM WATER. Then apply this product once or twice daily. When I had a sunburn, I used this product 3x but just light. I then noticed my skin gets hydrated, get cured from itchiness and helped me stop my pimples. I always tried to stop using this but I always end up buying it again. It’s the only product so far that is consistent to take care of my facial needs. The scent smells good too.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I’ve been using the Olay Super Serum for a few weeks now and I’m honestly impressed with how much it does in one step. My skin looks noticeably brighter and more even, and it feels super hydrated without being greasy or heavy. It absorbs quickly, which I love because I can layer moisturizer and makeup right after without any pilling. The texture is silky and lightweight, and a little goes a long way. I’ve also noticed my skin feels smoother and a bit firmer, especially around my cheeks. It gives a really nice healthy glow that looks natural, not shiny. If I had to mention one small thing, it’s that you need to use sunscreen during the day since it contains AHA — but that’s expected with brightening products anyway. Overall, this is a great all-in-one serum if you want brighter, smoother, more hydrated skin without using a bunch of separate products. I’d definitely repurchase and recommend it for anyone looking to simplify their skincare routine while still getting real results.

Don't waste your money on expensive department store serums—this Olay Super Serum is better than all of them! It’s lightweight, absorbs fast, smells amazing, and leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft, firm, and hydrated. My complexion looks brighter and smoother than it has in years. I’m on my second bottle and I am officially hooked!

I was concerned after purchasing this product and reading customer reviews before I received it from people that said it was terrible for their sensitive skin, and since I've always had sensitive skin, of course I still tried it, because what could possibly go wrong? There's no miracle cure for aging, but this stuff helped, especially on my hands, arms, and cleavage area. I put it on my face after trying it on those places, and there's some improvement so far.

avis.titre: Product appears to be plumping my skin
avis.texte: I have been very skeptical of claims about skincare products for decades. Rarely have they worked, even a little. I recently decided to give this product a try in conjunction with the new daytime/ nighttime creams that are worn on top of this serum. I first began noticing that the skin above and below my lips were becoming plumper feeling. I used the entire bottle for both day and night with the creams and my entire face feels hydrated but the daytime cream added moisture without greasiness so makeup could be applied on top. I just ordered three more bottles of the serum and will use it to assess continued improvement. I am 66 years of age and told I have very pretty skin for my age. I don’t lay in the sun, quit when I turned 30. I don’t use Botox, or fillers and have not had a facelift…..something to note when you see celebrity enforcements….they are never asked to attest that they are not getting cosmetic procedures too, while using the products they are endorsing. Hope this helps in your decísion-making.

avis.titre: I have concerns - I believe the product was tampered with
avis.texte: I love my Olay super serum “habit”. This is my second or third purchase of this product. That being said, this time around I had some concerns. Firstly, the Olay outer shipping box was glued so heavily it was almost painful to open. Next, the product box itself has been cut open at the bottom. It was not torn. It was clearly cut open at the bottom to avoid the tamper evident seals. When I opened the bottle I noticed the fluid / serum was not pink as it should be but white. It also did not have the same scent. I just knew that I didn’t want to risk using it so I am having to return it.

avis.titre: Good skin care doesn’t have to be super expensive start with a basics
avis.texte: My grandma used Olay her whole life and had pretty great skin so when I decided to take my skin seriously about a year ago, I started with Olay’s super serum and saw a noticeable difference. I also use aveeno moisturizer and some supplements but noticed more even texture and tone, slightly improved wrinkles, and just a brightness and radiance after starting this product. I don’t really want to throw my whole face on the Internet, but I put a blocked out before and after there are no filters on either of the photos. I think some of the difference can be attributed to diet and lifestyle as well, but I am a big believer in the serum making a large difference. I’m solidly middle age and people think I am in my late 20s to early 30s since I’ve started taking my skin seriously. My only critique is the packaging when the product starts running low. The little dropper doesn’t grab any product so you have to like manually pour the product out of the bottle which works, but you get variable amounts of product doing that whereas one dropper full is consistently enough.

avis.titre: Actually reduced the appearance of fine lines
avis.texte: I got serum for Christmas. Actually I had bought it as a gift to me. I told my hubby that I'd bought 2 things for myself, the serum being one of them. He got a little upset because he said he knew i wanted it and he was going to get it for my stocking! So in his guy way, he zelled me the money I'd spent on it so he could say he bought it for me. Which I actually thought was sweet. But long story long, gets us to today. March 26th, I've been using it once a day, to stretch it out, label says twice a day, for exactly 3 months. I'm sitting on the edge of the bed after my shower, ready to put on my makeup, my husband sits down next to me and says "I've been meaning to tell you. I've noticed that serum has worked really well" I said "on the fine lines?" And he said Yes! That's a totally unsolicited review. I had to laugh because as I told him. Guess you'll be buying me more then, I just ran out! So if you use once a day after a shower. You'll get significant results in 3 months. Faster if you use as directed, twice a day? Not sure. I'm using ot on my neck and decorate, so that's probably the equivalent of twice a day if you just use it on your face. But I turned 66 in February so a full body application would probably be helpful. Lol just joking. It's a good product and I reccomend it after a 3 month once daily trial and random husband compliment!
I just got my products today.It has great reviews It came packaged, great and filled to the top. I'll come back in 2 weeks and let you know what I think.

This is the only thing I’ve change in my skin care routine since I started using it it has help my acne calm down within a week of using it is better size bottle than I thought it would be it’s more smooth than thick it works better than the okay facial moisturizer I been using

avis.titre: Good but Olay needs serious quality control revamp
avis.texte: While I do like this product a lot, I have to say that of the the times I purchased this same bottle size, the quantity inside the bottles was different for every single purchase. Unfortunately I didn't have the foresight to photograph the first bottle I bought. Instead I only have the two bottles I most recently bought, neither of which have been used. Additionally, please now that all the bottles purchased were the exact same item, sold from this exact same seller on Amazon. When I bought bottle 1, I noticed that it was barely not than half full when I took it out of the box. However since I was excited to try a new product I didn't think much of it at the time. I assumed Olay would have measured everything properly to make sure everyone gets what they're playing for. I didn't notice that was weird until I ordered bottle 2. Immediately I noticed that bottle 2 was almost completely full, which I expected from bottle 1, but because it's been using bottle 1 for a while by then I didn't have photos or a comparison of any sort. I put bottle 2 back into the box unused and waited a while before ordering a third bottle. Once bottle 3 arrived it confirmed what I thought, which was that the amount of product you get in there varies a great deal. Bottle 3 was about 2/3s full right out of the box. I photographed bottles 2&3 with a strong backlight so that people can see how much product was in both of these unused bottles. The one with the most product in it is bottle 2, which was the

Olay has knocked it out of the park with this serum. The bottle arrives in a simple paper box with saftey seal, the bottle itself is gorgeous- glass with a rosegold squeeze dropper application top that feels and looks very luxurious. The serum is lightweight- and I did not expect is the pretty iridescent glow when applied to the face, but there is a very, very subtle nothing crazy or too much just enough highlighted glow when applied. The serum itself is very hydrating and makes the skin feel very smooth. After application, it sinks in immediately and feels lovely after gliding on to clean skin, there's no tacky stickiness or any sort of greasy or oily feel, it's just very smooth and "baby soft". My face had not had any adverse reactions or breakouts since addingvthis to my skincare routine. I am very impressed with this and the looks of the jar and the serum are definitely first class for a mid-level price serum. With only a couple drops needed per application the price is great. This should last for quite a while even using it twice a day as recommended in the morning and evening.

avis.titre: The OLAY SUPER line will revolutionize your skincare routine.
avis.texte: MY ⭐️RATINGS: 5⭐️- EXCEEDS MY EXPECTATIONS! TOP QUALITY & MUST HAVE. 20260824 I initially purchased this serum in its smaller size, Olay Super Serum - Glow Serum for Face 1.0 fl oz. I’m delighted to see that it’s now available in a larger size, as I genuinely enjoy using it for my skin. As I navigate the perimenopause phase of menopause, my skin has undergone significant changes. One of the most challenging aspects is maintaining proper hydration. Since incorporating the serum into my routine, I’ve noticed a remarkable improvement in my skin’s condition. It has become more supple, smooth, and radiant. This serum is an all-in-one solution that delivers on its promises. My skin has undergone a dramatic transformation since I started using it. I’ve since expanded my OLAY SUPER LINE product collection. Recently, I acquired their cleansing cloth and Olay Super Facial Cleanser to thoroughly cleanse my face. After cleansing, I apply this serum and then finish with the Olay Super Cream without SPF. This entire line has streamlined my morning and night facial routine. EXPIRATION DATE: 12M AFTER OPENING I always check for an expiration date before using health and beauty products, especially. This Serum is PRICED in the usual range.

avis.titre: Excelente textura y muy agradable de usar

Tiene una textura muy ligera, se absorbe rápidamente y no deja la piel pegajosa ni con sensación grasosa. Después de aplicarlo, mi rostro se siente hidratado y suave, lo que hace que también funcione muy bien antes del maquillaje. El envase con gotero facilita aplicar la cantidad justa de producto y la presentación es muy bonita. Aunque los resultados en el cuidado de la piel toman tiempo y constancia, mi primera impresión ha sido muy positiva por lo cómodo que es de usar y la sensación que deja en la piel. En general, es una excelente opción para quienes buscan incorporar un sérum ligero e hidratante a su rutina diaria. Sin duda, seguiré utilizándolo para ver cómo evoluciona mi piel con el uso continuo.

avis.titre: I’m fond of products with Niacinamide👍⭐️
avis.texte: I have become very fond of serums with Niacinamide. The Olay Super Serum has balanced the oil on my face. I used to have oiler areas, and now they all are blended. Having my face not be as oily has dramatically changed my skin. It’s hydrated, smooth and supple. HOW I USE: AM & PM 1 - Cleanse my face & use toner. 2 - I apply 4-5 drops of this serum to my face. 3 - LAST, I finish with my usual moisturizer. I find if I want results, I must be consistent and patient. Missing applications slow the benefits of the product on my skin. Olay Super Serum goes well with the other skincare products that are part of my regimen. 🚨🚨 You should always thoroughly dry your skin & hands before applying any serums. Then, ensure the serum has been absorbed into your skin before applying moisturizer. If you don’t use it correctly, you’ll get a sticky, icky feel. EXPIRATION DATE: NONE! I always check for an expiration date before using, ESPECIALLY with health & beauty products. This particular product does not have one, then I do not keep it longer than 12 months after opening. PROPERLY SEALED: ✅ It is important to me how manufacturers seal & ship their products. This item was PROPERLY SEALED, as you can see from the pictures. To me, this means the manufacturer cares about its products.✔️ The PRICE for this serum is in the usual range. It’s exactly as advertised, and works well.

The Olay Super Serum is a powerhouse serum, with the power of 5 serums in one: niacinamide, vitamin C, collagen peptide, vitamin E and alpha hydroxy acid. I am a true believer in using a serum as a base in your skincare regime morning and night and this super serum eliminates having to keep track of using various serums to get these same ingredients. The best thing about this serum is it absorbs fast and is so smooth on your skin. The main thing I find annoying with other serums is when they go on sticky and don’t absorb fast enough. No worries with this Olay product! I have come to use and love Olay products over the years and this serum is no different. I love that it is made in the USA and the bottle is substantial at 1.7 ounces and should last me several months, making this a great value. There is a light, clean powdery scent with this serum and the color of the serum is an iridescent pink. I am usually sensitive to heavy scents in products and have had no adverse reaction to this product. Since this product contains AHA, you should be mindful to avoid excessive sun exposure and use a sunscreen for a week after starting to use this product. I love this serum and my skin has been looking better than ever!

So far, I really love this product. I’ve used Olay most of my life. Recently I tried the high-end salon products, too expensive, and I really can’t tell a difference. After using my evening regiment, in the morning my skin feels so soft, not dry at all. After the morning regiment, my skin feels good all day. I sent a photo of what I use morning and night. Only the eye cream goes after the serum, and before the Argan oil. The two jars that are stacked, one is for the morning, the other for the evening.

This is a good product, but looking at the ingredients, there's nothing super special about what's in it. I find these ingredients in many K-beauty products, and a lot of the K-beauty products are about half the price of this. If you can get this on sale, then it is a great serum, but at the current price, I feel like you could do just as well with some of the other beauty products out there.

The thing I like most about this serum is that is absorbs very quickly and leaves absolutely no greasy or tacky feeling on my face. Has a nice light scent, and a texture that is fairly thick. My skin looks smooth and even after use. If you use this serum in the morning you should definitely use sunscreen before going out. A high quality serum with ingredients to help improve skin tone, texture, and firmness.

I bought the Day and Night versions I ended up giving away a half container of the day version (I went back to my original pink Oil of Olay for daytime) and kept using the Night Repair Olay Super Serum religiously because I was desperately seeking results to no avail. Nope I’m sorry I don’t see anything like all these reviews say. Maybe if you never used anything before then started using this you saw results but I’ve been using or tried EVERYTHING Oil of Olay has put out and I always go back to the regular pink bottle combined with the Oil of Olay Regenerist Serum. This new overpriced “Super” serums feel and smell nice going on but that’s all the results I received. I’m 65 and kind of a skin fanatic and it really irks me to see anyone using the wrong product because the ads and commercials using 20 year old models with baby butt skin tell us we can get skin just like hers if we buy this product. I’m sorry but I had to speak up. There’s some great OTC facial creams and serums from $10 to $100+ I know I’ve bought most of them but always go back to basics and I get a lot of compliments on my skin. Be careful with your money ladies.

avis.titre: Great way to simplify your routine.
avis.texte: The first thing I noticed about this serum is how pretty it is. The serum is a pale pearlescent pink. I did not like the smell though. I can't quite think of what it reminds me of. It doesn't linger, so I"m okay with it. The serum feels silky going on. I use it after washing and toning. It makes, my skin feel soft, smooth and moisturized. I follow it with a sunscreen during the day and a moisturizer at night. There's no need to use other serums when using this. I love that it's a multipurpose serum. I've been using it less than a week, so I can't speak of long term results, but so far my skin looks and feels smoother and firmer after using this. I like it a lot.

I was really excited to use this because I have no issues with the retinol cream in the purple tub. But I believe due to the fragrance or something it made my skin texture rough, uncomfortable, and tight. Too bad… I’ll stick to my previous routine.

avis.titre: A fee drops goes a long way
avis.texte: After face cleaning and toner , I been applying the serum , the serum itself has some kind of shimmery and it melt pretty well into the skin. I felt my face being a little tighten afterward. No scent and just easy on my skin.

This is such a pretty serum. It says it is really five serum’s in one because it contains five key ingredients. I love the glow it adds to my skin. It is not irritating and does not cause breakouts or flaking.

avis.titre: Super happy for Suoer Serum at Super Price!
avis.texte: Ordinarily, I used quite a few bottles of another serum brand. I saw this on Prime Day and decided to try it. I’ve never seen it before. Olay is such a trusted brand, so I was hoping for a good product. First of all is a big ample size. It has all of the ingredients of four other products that I use. This will replace several bottles that take up room on my counter. All for a Super Price! The bottle should last a few months, but I will buy again,even at full price.

It is silky and smooth (not greasy) my skin in about a week hasn't been dry and it's balancing and brightening my skin. Age/sun spots are half the darkness. 40 feels like the new 20 with this product! My skin with moisturizer alone still felt like my face was super dry and my foundation looked horrible. This makes your skin soft, it isn't a targeting serum. It is a little bit of everything, vitamin C, and E, Alpha Hydroxy Acid, collagen peptide, and Nitacinamide. I do love this product but when I had first gotten it the bottle was not full. Disappointed a little but over all would probably buy again!

Olay is the only brand I’ve used all my life, but when my daughter gifted me this serum for Christmas I notice the difference in ONE WEEK!!! Absolutely love it! Use it in the morning before my make up and at night before going to bed. Highly recommended!!!

avis.titre: Fantastic. I wish I had a before picture.
avis.texte: I love this product, I added it to my skincare routine (face scrub, antioxidant spray, moisturizer, sun screen). I'd been looking really dehydrated and the bags under my eyes had been heavy. Within a few days of use I could see the difference. I'm in my mid 30s but steadily have been gettting carded again and having the stray conversation where someone says, "you're too young to understand". A stellar accidental compliment if you ask me.
The product feels very nice on my skin and gives my face a glow

I have used other Olay products in the past and it was hit or miss to be honest. This serum looks like it has tiny bits of glitter in it but you do not see it on your skin. It goes on smoothly and has a very nice scent to it. I have been using every day for a week now and will say that the texture of my face is smoother. It has all the key ingredients to be a great addition to my face routine I tried using it at night time but found that it doesn’t work well with another product I use at night. I do caution that you should use sunscreen on your face if you are outside a lot, using this product may cause more sun sensitivity. Overall I think it’s a great serum and I’m going to use the whole bottle.
